name: 05 - PLN Multi-Customer Gemini OCR & Auto Report Sheet Builder (v14.3)

nodes.name: Process PDFs Sequentially
nodes.notes: Batch size 1; setiap PDF diproses sampai selesai sebelum PDF berikutnya.

parameters.text: You extract exactly 11 fields from an Indonesian PLN electricity billing PDF. Read table columns carefully, including Stand Awal and Stand Akhir for LWBP, WBP, kVArh. Return ONLY a single valid JSON object (no markdown), keys exactly: id_pelanggan (string), nama_pelanggan (string), jatuh_tempo_bulan (Indonesian month string), jatuh_tempo_tahun (integer), total_harus_dibayar (integer rupiah), stand_akhir_lwbp (decimal string), stand_akhir_wbp (decimal string), stand_awal_lwbp (decimal string), stand_awal_wbp (decimal string), stand_akhir_kvarh (decimal string), stand_awal_kvarh (decimal string). Use null if unreadable or absent, but an explicitly printed zero is "0". Only take month and year from Jatuh Tempo, not billing month. Remove thousands separators in meter readings, preserve precision and trailing decimal zeros. Example: 173,446.440 => "173446.440". Do not infer, calculate, or manufacture readings. The field total_harus_dibayar must be from Total Yang Harus Dibayarkan, not any subtotal.

nodes.name: Generate PLN Report Auto Template
nodes.notes: v14.3: Mengambil technician langsung dari Validate 11 Fields. Jika Apps Script gagal di 1 PDF, batch tetap lanjut ke PDF berikutnya.

nodes.name: Verify PLN Report Links
nodes.notes: v14.3: Tidak menghentikan sisa antrean PDF jika 1 laporan gagal dibuat.

nodes.name: Log OCR Needs Review
nodes.notes: Menampung PDF yang gagal validasi 11 field agar mudah dicek atau dihubungkan ke notifikasi/Sheet Review.

nodes.name: Pause Before Next PDF
nodes.notes: Jeda 3 detik setelah laporan atau review, sebelum melanjutkan PDF berikutnya.
